title: 1736 Prairie's card stops showing the other McBirney house
items: The 1736 Prairie card led with the 1890 Inland Architect picture of Hugh J. McBirney's new stone house. That is the son's house at 1625 Prairie, not his father's older house at 1736. The archive files the picture under 1736, and we had kept that address. The picture now shows on 1625's card only. 1736's card now leads with the 1893 Rand McNally street view, with its arrow on the house. Its Images tab opens on the house's own photograph of about 1890. The 1736 model was always built from that 1890 photograph, so its shape does not change.
The 1889 building permit for the son's house moves from 1736 to 1625 as well.
Glessner House's Images tab gains three close-up photographs of its carved stone capitals.
